This notebook is a thin RStudio entry point for the versioned batch script.
Keeping one executable source prevents the Stan data preparation, censoring,
diagnostics, and reconstruction logic from drifting between `.R` and `.Rmd`
copies.

```{r run-v3p2, echo=TRUE}
batch_script <- file.path(
  "code", "bayes", "stir-bayes-load_v3p2_physical_event.R"
)
if (!file.exists(batch_script)) {
  stop("Run this notebook from the repository root; missing: ", batch_script)
}
source(batch_script, chdir = FALSE)
```
